_about: Quests. objective.type: defeat (target = monster id, omit for any) | capture | hatch (a pet egg) | reachLevel (count = level) | chooseClass | cards (count = kinds of monster card in the Monster Book; the cards are only shown, never handed over) | bring (count of the item target in the bag, handed over when you complete it: from `drops`, a chest that opens once the quest's taken (maps.json `quest`), a shop, or made by hand from the bag, items.json `make`). `drops`: while the quest's on, beaten wild monsters of the species `from` drop `item` `chance` of the time, till you have `upTo` (the objective's count unless set). `requires` lists quests that must be completed first. `question` is asked on accepting; each answer's `egg` decides what hatches from the Pet Egg. `giver` is an NPC id from maps.json.

quests.title: Hope of Meadowbrook
quests.description: Elder Oak gives every new adventurer three gifts: a wooden sword, a novice ring and a pet egg. Hatch your egg from the Bag, then come back to me.

question.text: Before you go, tell me: what do you treasure most?

quests.title: Jelly Trouble
quests.description: Jelly Puffs keep sliming our vegetable patch! Head east to Sunny Meadow and defeat 3 of them.

quests.title: A New Friend
quests.description: Every adventurer needs friends. Take these Seal Stones and throw one at a monster with Capture: the weaker it is, the better your odds. Each throw uses a stone up, and it may take a few tries!

quests.title: Wish Upon a Star
quests.description: Long ago a star fell by Meadowbrook's well, and its light still sleeps in a Wishing Seal: a stone that never fails. Befriend three more monsters, show me you'll be kind to them, and it's yours.

quests.title: Choose Your Path
quests.description: Reach level 10, then speak to a guild master in town to choose your path: Fighter, Mage or Beast Tamer.

quests.title: Pineapple Harvest
quests.description: Pineapple Sprouts have taken over Pineapple Shore, south of Meadowbrook. Defeat 5.

quests.title: The Bouncy Menace
quests.description: Something bounces in the dark of Twilight Woods, east of Sunny Meadow. Defeat 3 Bouncy Buns.

quests.title: Swamp Song
quests.description: Frogs croak all night south of Sunny Meadow and nobody can sleep! Quiet 4 Treefrogs in Frog Swamp.

quests.title: Monkey Business
quests.description: Wood Monkeys from the Smiling Forest, east of Gumdrop Peaks, keep stealing our apples. Defeat 5.

quests.title: Sheep Shearing
quests.description: The Flame Sheep of the Smiling Forest have set the market awnings alight again. Defeat 4, please!

quests.title: Lights in the Valley
quests.description: Strange lights drift through Shiverdell, south of Twilight Woods. Defeat 4 Wisps and see what's there.

quests.title: The Rat King
quests.description: The dwarves of Ingothold are cut off! A Rat King has taken over the cavern east of Shiverdell. Defeat him.

quests.title: Dragon Hangover
quests.description: A dragon's been drinking at the oasis in Genie Desert, east of town, and scaring off the caravans. Sober him up… with force.

quests.title: Crystal Hearts
quests.description: We need Gem Crawler shells for the forge. Defeat 4 on Crystal Mountain, south of Ingothold.

quests.title: Who's Afraid of the Big Bad Wolf?
quests.description: A Big Bad Wolf prowls the Snow White Forest, east of the Smiling Forest, and no one dares take the road north to Moonwhisper. Be brave, and be careful.

quests.title: Lost Little Lambs
quests.description: Baa! Golden Hamsters keep stuffing their cheeks with the clover my little lambs need. Shoo away 3 of them and my lambs can graze again.

quests.title: Shell Snatchers
quests.description: Click-clack! Those Mud Eagles swoop down and snatch the prettiest shells off my beach. Chase off 3 of them for an old crab, will you?

quests.title: Straw, Sticks and Bricks
quests.description: My brothers built houses of straw and sticks, and now Tree Snakes keep coiling round them! Chase off 5 Tree Snakes so we can finish the house of bricks before the wolf comes.

quests.title: Moonlight Thieves
quests.description: The Shade Puffs are drinking up the moonlight, and without it I fade away. Pop 4 Shade Puffs and let the light come back to Twilight Woods.

quests.title: The Frog Prince
quests.description: A kiss? Goodness, no. What I need is my golden ball back from the pond, and the Water Slugs are guarding it. Defeat 4 Water Slugs and a prince's reward is yours.

quests.title: The Ugly Duckling
quests.description: The Mud Slimes splash mud on my feathers and laugh at me. Would you make them stop? Defeat 4 Mud Slimes. One day I'll be a swan, you'll see!

quests.title: The Lion and the Mouse
quests.description: An Earth Lion once spared my life, so now I look out for him. The Blaze Bulls keep stampeding through his den! Defeat 3 Blaze Bulls and we'll both owe you one.

quests.title: Puss in Boots
quests.description: My master the Marquis needs a clear road to his castle, but Black Widows keep spinning webs across it. Clear away 4 Black Widows and I'll tip my hat to you.

quests.title: Stormy Crystals
quests.description: Golden Clouds keep raining on my crystals until they go dull. Chase off 4 Golden Clouds so the mountain can sparkle again.

quests.title: Melting Friends
quests.description: The Fire Bears keep hugging my snowman friends, and you can guess how that ends. Defeat 3 Fire Bears before we all turn into puddles!

quests.title: Stardust's Night Flight
quests.description: I can't fly under the moon while Poison Skeletons haunt Moonwhisper. Defeat 4 of them and I'll carry your name across the stars.

quests.title: The Gilded Brute
quests.description: Gooey Grotto, west of the Windswept Downs, is full of Golden Slimes. Their master calls himself the Gilded Brute. Defeat him.

quests.title: The Wandering Flock
quests.description: The wolves of Gumdrop Peaks took Mother Sheep's lambs to the Big Bad Wolf's Lair, west of the mountain. Thin out their pack: defeat 6 Earth Wolves.

quests.title: The Howlmaster
quests.description: The pack still follows its leader. Find the Howlmaster deep in the lair and bring those lambs home.

quests.title: Soft as a Cloud
quests.description: I need wool for a very special dress, the kind a swan would wear. Candy Puffs spin the softest fluff; bring me what 8 of them leave behind.

quests.title: An Ugly Duckling's Wish
quests.description: The little grey duckling of Swan Lake hides from the Water Slugs. Clear 6 of them so it can swim out and meet the swans.

quests.title: A Little Kindness
quests.description: The Lotus Sprites won't let me cross the pond to see my prince. Would you shoo away 6 of them? Gently, please.

quests.title: A Place to Belong
quests.description: The Wooden Puppets chased every animal off Marionette Rise. Break 8 of them and the animals can come home.

quests.title: The Marionette King
quests.description: The puppets dance for their king at the top of the hill. Cut his strings for good.

quests.title: Mystery of the Dreamstone
quests.description: Dreamstone Golems roll about Ingothold Lake. Their cores glow like the goddess Liora's treasure. Defeat 6 and let me study one.

quests.title: Treasures of Goddess Liora
quests.description: The ore points south, to the Hidden Steppe. Morvane guards the goddess's treasure there, and can hit for thousands. Bring a strong party.

quests.title: Sleeping Rosalind
quests.description: The Dream Phantoms keep Dozywick dreaming. Defeat 8 of them, then wake Rosalind by beating the Craghulk that snores in the cave.

quests.title: The Craghulk
quests.description: Now the monster itself. It's big, it's stone, and it has been asleep for a year. Wake it up the hard way.

quests.title: Ore of Sneezle Sands
quests.description: Even bigger golems live on Sneezle Sands, south of the Hidden Steppe. Defeat 10 and the mystery of the ore is solved.

quests.title: The Temple Below
quests.description: Temple Jellies drift up from the sunken Tidewater Shrine. Defeat 10 of them and the way down will clear.

quests.title: The Wavecrest Dragon
quests.description: The Wavecrest Dragon sleeps in the deepest hall of the Tidewater Shrine. Wake it, and end it.

quests.title: The Silverfang Warden
quests.description: The Silverfang Warden holds the Whispering Hollow, the only way to this road. Defeat him so travellers can pass.

quests.title: Crystal Widows
quests.description: Crystal Widows spin webs across the cave mouth. Clear 10 of them.

quests.title: At the End of the Road
quests.description: The Emerald Dragon waits at the gate of the Emerald City. Only a hero near level 200 should try.

quests.title: Turn That Frown Upside Down
quests.description: The oldest oak in Smiling Forest has stopped smiling and swats anyone who walks by. Cheer it up... the hard way.

quests.title: Follow the Pretty Light
quests.description: Travellers keep wandering off the road in Shiverdell, chasing a giant glowing wisp. Snuff out its tricks.

quests.title: The Missing Moon-Mochi
quests.description: The Moon Rabbit Queen has come down to Moonwhisper, furious that someone stole her moon-mochi. Calm her before she flattens the town... with force.

quests.title: Models Wanted
quests.description: Monsters leave their cards behind now and then. Find five kinds and show me: I'll copy them into toys, and a couple of my best are yours!

quests.title: A Shelf of Monsters
quests.description: Every one of those toys sold before lunch! Show me fifteen kinds of card and I'll fill a whole shelf. There's a soldier and some blocks in it for you.

quests.title: The Toy Parade
quests.description: Thirty kinds of card, and Prismhaven gets a toy parade! I'll share the music box. And the bubbles. And a bear!

quests.title: Rare and Wonderful
quests.description: The rare ones and the big ones too, if you can: fifty kinds of card. One of each of my finest toys for you.

quests.title: The Hundred-Toy Shelf
quests.description: A hundred kinds of monster card! Nobody has ever done it. If you do, you'll have one of every toy I make.

quests.title: Four Oxen and a Lion
quests.description: My three friends and I stood tail to tail, and no lion could reach us. Then we quarrelled and went our own ways, and the Earth Lions have picked us off ever since. Drive off 8 of them.

quests.title: Thunder on the Steppe
quests.description: Golden Clouds roll over the steppe, and their thunder sends the wild bulls stampeding through the herd. Chase off 5 of them so we can graze in peace.

quests.title: The Waterhole
quests.description: Black Bulls have taken the waterhole and let no one else drink. Drive off 10 of them, and tell my friends we'll stand together again.

quests.title: The Monkey and the Crab
quests.description: A Wood Monkey traded me a seed for my rice ball. I grew it into a persimmon tree, and the monkeys climbed it and pelted me with the hard green fruit! Teach 10 Wood Monkeys some manners.

quests.title: Persimmons for Everyone
quests.description: Now the Mint Shadow Apes come down from the hills for the ripe ones. Drive off 6, and the whole coast can share the harvest.

quests.title: Wool for the Lambs
quests.description: The golden hamsters pulled tufts of wool from my lambs to line their burrows, and now the poor dears shiver at night. Bring me 5 Tufts of Wool from the hamsters and I'll knit them new coats.

quests.title: A Flute for Shelly
quests.description: A mud eagle carried off my driftwood flute, the one that calls my grandchildren home. Carve me a new one! The wood crabs hoard driftwood: win a piece from them, then carve it with 2 White Poplar from your bag.

quests.title: A Spare Sail
quests.description: Captain Brine won't cross open water without a spare sail: the winds past the reef tore the Gull's last one to ribbons. The fire crabs drag washed-up sailcloth into their burrows. Win back 4 Sailcloth Scraps from them.

quests.title: A Figurehead for the Gull
quests.description: No sailor crosses to Starfall Isle without a figurehead to watch the stars. The wood monkeys hoard Starwood in their grove: win a piece, then carve the figurehead yourself with 3 Red Yew from your bag.

quests.title: The Star Chart
quests.description: The chart to Starfall Isle blew apart in the same storm. One piece landed in an old chest on Sneezle Sands, an Earth Lion on the Hidden Steppe carried off another, and a Mint Shadow Ape ran off with the third. Find all three, piece the chart together and bring it to Captain Brine.

quests.title: The Lanterns of Glimmerbough
quests.description: Starmoths drink the light from Glimmerbough's lanterns, and each night the village grows a little darker. Win back 6 pinches of Starlight Dust from their wings, so Pip can light them again.

quests.title: The Sleeping Moonflowers
quests.description: Nebula Puffs drift down from the hills at dusk and settle on our moonflowers until they wilt. Drive off 12 of them, and the flowers can open again.

quests.title: The Crystal Garden
quests.description: Crystal Quills keep digging up the crystals I grow my lantern glass from. Teach 10 of them to dig somewhere else!

quests.title: A Lantern for the Stargazer
quests.description: Stargazer Lune watches the sky all night by the light of a candle stub. Let's make her a Star Lantern! Win a Starfall Shard from a Crystal Quill, then join it to 3 pinches of Starlight Dust from your bag.

quests.title: The Fallen Star
quests.description: Long ago a star fell on this island, and Glimmerbough grew up round the crystals it left. Now it has woken on the hill, lonely and far from home, and its light burns anyone who comes near. Calm it, and help it find its way back to the sky.

quests.title: Hamsters in the Granary
quests.description: Golden Hamsters have found my granary, and they've been stuffing their cheeks all week. Shoo four of them off before there's no flour left for Cloverdale's bread!

quests.title: The Clover Thieves
quests.description: My bees won't leave the hive! The Yellow Butterflies have taken over the clover and won't share a single flower. Chase five of them off, and my bees will thank you. Quietly. They're shy.

quests.title: Seeds for Spring
quests.description: Those hamsters didn't only eat the grain. They ran off with my seed pouches, every one, and spring planting is next week! Bring back four, and Barnaby and I will have something for you.

quests.title: Socks on the Hedgehogs
quests.description: A gust took my whole washing line last night! Now the Hedgehogs are trundling round the Downs with my socks stuck on their spines. Bring back five socks. Odd ones are fine.

quests.title: A Hamster for Kite Day
quests.description: Every Kite Day, a brave little friend rides in the basket of the lead kite. Seal a Golden Hamster with these Seal Stones and bring it along. It stays your friend after, of course.

quests.title: Kite Day
quests.description: Kite Day is here, and the Fluffy Bunnies keep nibbling through the kite strings! Chase eight of them off so every kite in Thistledown can fly.

quests.title: Crabs in the Nets
quests.description: The Wood Crabs have found my nets, and they snip through the knots faster than I can tie them. Send six of them scuttling, and I'll have these nets mended before the tide.

quests.title: The Stolen Catch
quests.description: Every time the boats come in, the Mud Eagles swoop down and fly off with the best of the catch. Win five Silver Fish back from them, and the whole cove eats tonight.

quests.title: A Light on the Point
quests.description: The lamp on the point went out in last week's storm, and the boats can't find the cove at night. Gather three Glow Shells from the Wood Crabs, piece them together on a frame of White Poplar, and bring me the lantern.

quests.title: Gold in the Goo
quests.description: The Golden Slimes swallow every nugget we dig up, then wobble off with them! Pop five of them and bring the gold back. Goldie will want to weigh it, of course.

quests.title: Lights Out
quests.description: The Mud Slimes keep oozing over our lanterns and putting them out, and nobody can dig in the dark. Clear eight of them out of the tunnels, and the camp's lamps stay lit.

quests.title: Shells for the Lanterns
quests.description: My lantern glass has run out, so I make do with Dark Beetle shells. Polished up, they glow a lovely violet. Bring me six, and Duskhollow stays lit.

quests.title: Werewolves at the Woodpile
quests.description: Something knocks over my woodpile every night and howls about it. Werewolves, five of them at least. Teach them some manners, and my kilns can burn again.

quests.title: The Night Market
quests.description: Once a month Duskhollow holds a market by lantern light, and this time the Night Monkeys are raiding the stalls before we've even opened! Chase eight of them off, and the market's yours.

quests.title: Monkeys in the Orchard
quests.description: The Wood Monkeys raid my trees every morning and run off with the best apples. Win six back from them. I'd like to save a few for the fair.

quests.title: Hog Wild
quests.description: The Wood Hogs dig up truffles all over the forest and gobble them before anyone else gets a sniff. Bring me five, and I'll brew Hollyhock's famous Truffle Cider. It's an acquired taste.

quests.title: The Apple Fair
quests.description: The Flame Sheep keep wandering into the orchard and toasting the apples on the branch. Toasted apples are lovely, but not before the fair! Herd six of them away.

quests.title: Sticky Fingers
quests.description: The Candy Puffs have been licking my sugar crystals clean off the rocks! Pop five of them and bring the crystals back. I need them for Peppermint Row's rock candy.

quests.title: Toffee Too Hot
quests.description: Toffee's all about the heat, and the Flame Sheep keep wandering through my kitchen and burning every batch! Herd six of them away from Peppermint Row.

quests.title: The Gingerbread Gala
quests.description: Every year Peppermint Row crowns a Gala Queen, and every year the crown gets eaten. This year it's rock candy: piece four Sugar Crystals together round a piece of Amber, and bring me the crown.

quests.title: Croaking Under the Boardwalk
quests.description: The Blue Treefrogs croak under the boardwalks all night, and nobody in Bogbottom has slept in a week. Quiet six of them down, and we'll all thank you. In the morning. After a nap.

quests.title: Mud for the Poultice
quests.description: Mud Slimes are made of the best mud in the swamp, the warm, healing kind. Bring me five dollops for my poultices. Don't ask how I found out.

quests.title: Slime on the Stilts
quests.description: The Water Slugs climb our stilts at night and leave everything as slippery as soap. Old Bess fell in twice yesterday! Clear ten of them out, and Bogbottom can stand up straight again.

quests.title: Little Red's Basket
quests.description: I was taking a basket of honey muffins to Grandmother when the Earth Wolves knocked me over and ran off with them! Get five muffins back. Grandmother can tell if one's missing. She counts.

quests.title: Wolves at the Window
quests.description: The Flame Wolves prowl round my cottage every night and breathe on the windows till the glass steams up. Chase eight of them off and let an old woman get some sleep.

quests.title: The Long Howl
quests.description: The Werewolves howl at Grandmother's cottage all night long. Huntsman Corwin says they only want the muffins, but I'm not taking chances. Make four of them think twice.

quests.title: Frogs in the Ferry
quests.description: The Treefrogs have taken to jumping into my ferry halfway across, and one of them steered us into the reeds yesterday! Clear eight of them off the lake so Reedwater can cross in peace.

quests.title: Wisp-Light Thread
quests.description: My finest lace is stitched with thread spun from wisp-light. The Wisps drift over the lake at dusk, trailing it behind them. Bring me five skeins of their glow.

quests.title: A Veil for Odette
quests.description: The swan girl on the island has watched over Reedwater for years, and nobody has ever given her anything. Piece three skeins of Wisp Silk together with an Emerald clasp, and we'll send her the finest veil the lake has seen.

quests.title: Lions at the Lantern Fence
quests.description: The Earth Lions prowl round our lantern fence every night, roaring at the candles. Send six of them back to the hills, and Candlewick's children can sleep again.

quests.title: Horn Lanterns
quests.description: In Shiverdell a candle needs a horn lantern round it, or the first gust and the first Wisp put it out. Bring me five horns from the Bulls. They grow new ones, don't worry.

quests.title: The Silent Bell
quests.description: A Night Monkey climbed the belfry and ran off with the bell's clapper, and now the valley's gone quiet. Without the bell, everyone feels alone in the dark. Get it back!

quests.title: Too Many Rats
quests.description: The Fire Rats breed faster than I can count, and I count fast. Thin them out, ten of them, and the camp might last the week.

quests.title: Rat-Proof Boots
quests.description: Earth Snakes shed scales as hard as iron, and nothing makes a better boot. Not even a Fire Rat can bite through it. Bring me five, and I'll make you a pair too.

quests.title: Sprites in the Dew
quests.description: The Lotus Sprites drink the morning dew before I can gather it, and dew is all we tiny folk drink! Win back six Dew Pearls from them. They're round, and very, very clean.

quests.title: Slugs on the Lily Pads
quests.description: The Water Slugs are eating the lily pads, and half of Lilypad Landing lives on lily pads! Send eight of the gluttons packing before we're all swimming.

quests.title: The Lantern Float
quests.description: Every summer we float a lantern down the stream for luck, and this year it's your turn to make it! Piece three Dew Pearls together on a stick of Bamboo, and bring the lantern to me.

quests.title: Beetles in the Workshop
quests.description: Dark Beetles bore into my wood and turn good puppets into sieves. Squash eight of them before they reach the workshop, and Stringwood's toys are safe.

quests.title: Cut Strings
quests.description: The runaway puppets still trail their golden strings, and every string is a little bit of magic. Snip six of them free and bring them back to me.

quests.title: The Midsummer Show
quests.description: The Midsummer Show starts at dusk, and the wild puppets want to take over the stage again! Round up twelve of them, so for once the show goes the way I wrote it.

quests.title: Lizards in the Well
quests.description: The Black Lizards climb down into the well to cool off, and then they won't climb out! Chase eight of them away before the caravans arrive thirsty.

quests.title: Wicks of Light
quests.description: A lamp burns brightest with a Light Hedgehog's quill for a wick. They shed them all over the dunes, but only when you've given them a good reason. Bring me five.

quests.title: The Genie's Lamp
quests.description: Storyteller Hakim swears a genie lived in the oasis long ago, and left when its lamp went dark. Piece three Sun Quills together round a Gold Ingot, and let's make a lamp worth coming home to.

quests.title: Hot Crabs
quests.description: Fire Crabs climb aboard every raft that comes in and set the ropes smouldering. Clear eight of them off the wharf before something important catches.

quests.title: Lizard-Licked Ore
quests.description: The Mining Lizards lick the ore off the rafts like it's candy, then wander off with a mouthful. Bring me back six lumps of Raw Ore, and my forge can roar again.

quests.title: Golems on the Rafts
quests.description: Dreamstone Golems have started riding the ore rafts down the lake, and they sink every one they sit on. Teach eight of them to walk, and Emberwharf's rafts can float again.

quests.title: Stones That Float
quests.description: The Floating Stones drift over our diggings and drop on whoever's below. Bring ten of them down for good, and Geode Hollow can dig without hard hats. Well, with fewer.

quests.title: Crawler Gems
quests.description: The Gem Crawlers swallow the rough gems we dig up and wear them on their backs. Win six of them back for my wheel.

quests.title: The Prism Lamp
quests.description: Geode Hollow has always wanted a lamp that throws rainbows on the mountain at night. Piece three Rough Gems together round a Diamond, and we'll light it on the highest roof.

quests.title: Bad Bedtime Stories
quests.description: The Phantoms drift through our walls every night and whisper bedtime stories, and they're terrible stories! Send eight of them off, so Wakewell can stay awake in peace.

quests.title: Beans for the Roaster
quests.description: The Poison Skeletons raided my bean sacks! Skeletons don't sleep either, so they drink a lot of coffee. Rattle six of them and bring back the beans.

quests.title: A Lullaby for Wakewell
quests.description: The Dream Phantoms have hoarded every good dream in the valley, and that's why nobody here can sleep. Win five Sweet Dreams back from them. Tonight, Wakewell sleeps!

quests.title: Bears at the Woodpile
quests.description: The Fire Bears come down for our firewood and set it alight before we've even carried it in. Send eight of them back up the mountain, and the seven hearths can burn on proper wood.

quests.title: Frost Apples
quests.description: The Snowmen roll through the orchard and the apples freeze right into them. Frost Apples are the sweetest thing in the forest! Bring me five for the dwarfs' pie. Don't worry, they're not poisoned.

quests.title: The Seven Hearths Feast
quests.description: Once a winter the seven dwarfs hold a feast by all seven hearths, and the Frost Bears always sniff it out. Keep eight of them away tonight, and you're our guest of honour.
